plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 9th house: they make growth and adventure feel lovely; you enjoy exploring, learning, and traveling together. Failure mode: affection cooling when the adventure pauses. Enjoy expanding together; build for the ordinary days too.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
